chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, altogether from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazie, from Salih ibn Uqba, from Yazeed ibn Abdul Malik al-Nawfaly, who said:

I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and in his hand was a pomegranate, so he said: 'O Mu'ttab! Give him a pomegranate, for there is nothing more hateful to me than being shared in something than being shared in a pomegranate.'

Then he had cupping done and ordered me to have cupping done, so I had cupping done. Then he called for another pomegranate and said: 'O Yazeed! Whoever of the believers eats a pomegranate until he finishes it, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, removes Satan from the illumination of his heart for forty mornings; and whoever eats two, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, removes Satan from the illumination of his heart for a hundred days; and whoever eats three until he finishes them, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, removes Satan from the illumination of his heart for a year; and whoever Allah removes Satan from the illumination of his heart for a year, he does not sin, and whoever does not sin enters Paradise.'
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual benefits of eating pomegranates according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links the physical act of consuming pomegranates to spiritual purification, specifically noting that Satan is removed from the 'illumination of the heart' (inarat al-qalb) for durations ranging from forty days to a full year. This removal of satanic influence is presented as a state of sinlessness (la yudhnib), which directly facilitates entry into Paradise, emphasizing the fruit's role in maintaining spiritual clarity. The hadith also underscores the virtue of sharing this blessed fruit, as the Imam begins by instructing his companion to give him a pomegranate.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, and Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, altogether from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, from Salih Bin Uqba, from Yazeed Bin Abdul Malik Al Nowfaly who said,

‘I went over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and in his<sup>asws</sup> hand was a Pomegranate, so he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Mo’tab! Give him a Pomegranate, for there is nothing more hateful to me<sup>asws</sup> in letting someone participating in something than letting him participate in a Pomegranate’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> had cupping done and ordered me that I should get cupping done. So I had cupping done. Then he<sup>asws</sup> called for another Pomegranate, then said: ‘O Yazeed! But rather, a Believer eats a Pomegranate until he completes eating it, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Sends the Satan<sup>la</sup> away from the illumination of his heart for forty mornings; and the one who eats two, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Sends the Satan<sup>la</sup> away from the illumination of his heart for a hundred days; and the one who eats three until he completes these, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Sends the Satan<sup>la</sup> away from the illumination of his heart for a year; and the one from whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sends the Satan<sup>la</sup> away from his heart for a year, would not sin, and the one who does not sin would enter the Paradise’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan all from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il ibn Bazi‘ from Salih ibn ‘Uqbah from Yazid ibn ‘Abd al-Malik al-Nawfaliy who has said the following: “I once visited abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and there was a pomegranate in his hand. He (the Imam) said, ‘O Mu‘attib give him a pomegranate; sharing of no other thing is more hateful to me than sharing a pomegranate.’
He (the Imam) then applied cupping and I also applied cupping.

He (the Imam) then asked for another pomegranate. He (the Imam) then said, ‘O Yazid, if any believing person eats a pomegranate completely, Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, dispels Satan from the brightness of his heart for forty days. If one eats two pieces completely Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, dispels Satan from the bright part of his heart for one hundred days. If one eats three pomegranates completely, Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, removes Satan from the brightness of his heart for one year. One from the brightness of whose heart Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, removes Satan, he does not commit sins and one who does not commit sins enters paradise.”’*
